_provenance.pii_note: email / contact / vpa and other identity fields are replaced with fixed placeholders (['card_holder_name', 'contact', 'customer_contact', 'customer_email', 'customer_name', 'email', 'name', 'vpa']) before writing. Redaction is applied unconditionally, whether or not the response contained any.
_provenance.note: Live test-mode capture of the payments collection, filtered to status=failed when any failed payments exist. The account returned an EMPTY collection - it holds no data of this kind, so this file records reachability and the envelope shape only, not the item shape.
_provenance.why_this_matters: error_reason is the correlation input. It is the free decline taxonomy that lets an unexplained settlement gap be attributed to a specific cause without any inference.
